name: enable_map_group

stack.evidence: func_001CFD58 consumes one group ID and passes it to func_00107FB8, which sets bit 1 << group_id in D_002B91E8

notes: D_002B91E8 is initialized from the current room's default group mask. func_00107338 intersects it with each map record's group mask, and func_00107360 skips disabled records before performing map-bounds visibility tests. All 31 JP calls use literal group IDs from 1 through 18. Twelve ew31 calls interleave command 62 with command 63 disable_map_group to select alternating groups; command 62 is the exact inverse operation.
